component.name: Katakomba
component.summary: Route all traffic through a VPN over Tor

description.p: Katakomba routes all of your computer's traffic through OpenVPN, whose connection itself travels through the Tor network. Your VPN provider sees a Tor exit node, never your real address; your Internet provider sees Tor, never your VPN or where you go.
A background service manages Tor, OpenVPN, DNS and reconnections, and a setup wizard only needs the configuration file downloaded from your VPN provider: it is adapted for Tor automatically.

ul.li: Kill switch: nothing leaves outside the tunnel, even during reconnections
Automatic failover between accounts and providers, and recovery after sleep
IPv6 blocking, the VPN's DNS applied on the tunnel, and split DNS for local domains
Built-in diagnostics that check routing, DNS and the real exit address
Desktop notifications when the connection drops and when it comes back
Advanced settings: network exclusions, LAN sharing, Tor circuit options

description.p: Requires a VPN provider offering OpenVPN over TCP. Expect a few megabits per second: fine for browsing, less so for HD video.

screenshot.caption: Connection status and the path your traffic takes
VPN providers and accounts, in failover order

description.p: Kill switch, on by default: while the service runs, nothing leaves outside the tunnel, even during reconnections. Only Tor itself, the local network, the local DNS server and the excluded networks bypass it. It is lifted when you disconnect.
Software centre metadata: Katakomba now shows its description, screenshots and release notes in GNOME Software and the Ubuntu App Center.
The package now depends on python3-gi-cairo: without it, the window crashed when opening on a minimal installation. The license is stated consistently as GPL-3.0.
New name: Katakomba. An installation made under the previous name is migrated automatically.

ul.li: Provider files are adapted for Tor automatically, as downloaded
Allowlists for OpenVPN and Tor configuration, Tor runs unprivileged
Faster recovery: OpenVPN alone is restarted when Tor is healthy
